comparison.objective: Safely remove battery-pack busbars after service-plug isolation and live-dead-live verification.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-sequenced plug extraction, meter probing, nut driving, and conductive-part handling.
comparison.success_condition: The body states the service plug and verification must precede nut removal and that parts must not bridge terminals; numeric scoring and tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: The central ability is electrical isolation and sequenced disassembly, not mechanical notch fracture by hammer and mandrel. Missing numeric rubric details do not create plausible overlap.
